title: Irrigation Pipe Prices in Kenya: HDPE, PVC & Rain Hose | DripTech
description: Compare irrigation pipe types, sizes, pressure ratings and public reference prices in Kenya. Check units carefully and request a current DripTech quotation.
intro: Irrigation pipe costs depend on material, diameter, pressure rating and the length supplied. This guide compares public supplier listings as a planning reference—not DripTech's own price list. Confirm current stock, exact specifications, delivery and tax before buying.

sections.heading: Public price references: compare like with like
paragraphs: Faulu Irrigation's guide dated 2 June 2026 lists indicative 100 m HDPE roll ranges: 16 mm KSh 1,500–1,700; 20 mm KSh 2,500–2,800; 32 mm KSh 4,100–4,500; and 63 mm KSh 12,500–17,000. Prices vary with size and pressure rating.

Grekkon's public irrigation-pipe guide lists HDPE pipe prices by diameter and PN class, with many entries expressed per metre rather than per roll. Convert units and confirm length before comparing suppliers.

Grekkon's rain-hose page lists examples per 100 m of KSh 2,500 for 32 mm, KSh 5,800 for 40 mm and KSh 6,800 for 50 mm, while another listing shows different values. Verify current prices and specifications directly.

sections.heading: What changes the final cost?
bullets: Diameter and total length for mainlines, submains and laterals
PN pressure rating and actual operating pressure
Material and use: HDPE, PVC, dripline or rain hose
Fittings, valves, connectors, delivery and installation
Whether the price is per metre, roll, coil or complete kit

sections.heading: Choose pipe by hydraulic requirements
paragraphs: A pipe that is too small can create excessive friction loss, while an inadequate pressure rating may not suit the system. Confirm flow, length, elevation, pump pressure and PN rating before selecting a size.
These are third-party public listings reviewed in October 2026. Prices may change and may exclude delivery or taxes. DripTech does not claim competitor prices as its own.

title: HDPE Pipe Prices in Kenya by Size & PN Rating | DripTech
description: Understand HDPE irrigation pipe prices by diameter, roll length and PN pressure class in Kenya, with third-party reference ranges and buying checks.
h1: HDPE pipe prices in Kenya by size
intro: HDPE pipe prices depend on diameter, PN rating, length and supplier specification. The figures here are public third-party references, not DripTech selling prices; verify availability and specifications before ordering.

sections.heading: Reference prices for common HDPE sizes
paragraphs: Faulu Irrigation's guide published 2 June 2026 lists indicative 100 m roll prices: 16 mm KSh 1,500–1,700; 20 mm KSh 2,500–2,800; 25 mm KSh 3,000–3,500; 32 mm KSh 4,100–4,500; 40 mm KSh 5,890–7,500; 50 mm KSh 8,000–11,000; and 63 mm KSh 12,500–17,000.
The same guide lists 75 mm at KSh 18,000–25,000, 90 mm at KSh 33,000–35,000 and 110 mm at KSh 43,000–45,000 per 100 m roll. Confirm roll length and the PN rating included in any quote.
Grekkon publishes HDPE prices by diameter and PN6–PN25 classes, often per metre. Compare only after matching size, pressure class and unit.

sections.heading: How to choose HDPE pipe
bullets: Select diameter from required flow and acceptable friction loss.
Match PN rating to maximum operating pressure and pump conditions.
Confirm whether the product is sold per metre, 50 m length or 100 m roll.
Check joining method, fittings and application requirements.
Ask for a written quote specifying diameter, PN rating, length and included fittings.

sections.heading: Before you buy
paragraphs: A cheaper pipe is not necessarily suitable for a high-pressure mainline. Verify flow, pressure and layout with an irrigation technician.

Reference listings were reviewed in October 2026 and may change. DripTech can help assemble a pipe-and-fitting list for your field; share the water source, crop, dimensions and flow requirement for a current quotation.

title: Rain Hose Prices in Kenya: 32 mm, 40 mm & 50 mm | DripTech
description: Compare public rain hose price examples in Kenya by diameter and roll length, and learn what to check about flow, pressure and fittings.
intro: Rain hose distributes water through small perforations and can suit selected crops and field layouts. Prices depend on diameter, length, quality and accessories. The examples below are third-party public listings, not DripTech prices.

sections.heading: Public rain hose price examples
paragraphs: Grekkon's public page lists 100 m examples: 32 mm at KSh 2,500, 40 mm at KSh 5,800 and 50 mm at KSh 6,800. A separate Grekkon listing gives KSh 2,500, KSh 3,500 and KSh 4,500 for those sizes, so confirm the current price and exact product directly.
Check roll length, product specification, flow requirement, pressure/head conditions and whether connectors or end caps are included.

sections.heading: What to check before choosing rain hose
bullets: Diameter and flow required for crop and plot
Water source, pump capacity and available operating head
Hose length, perforation pattern and coverage
Connectors, end caps, valves and mainline pipe
Crop sensitivity to wet foliage and local disease pressure

sections.heading: Rain hose or drip irrigation?
paragraphs: Rain hose wets a broader area and may suit some short crops, nurseries and open-field layouts. Drip irrigation delivers water at emitters near the root zone and may be preferable where foliage wetting should be limited. The better option depends on crop, soil, water quality, wind, pressure and layout—not only initial roll price.
Third-party price examples were reviewed in October 2026 and may change. Ask for a current written quote and verify whether the amount covers hose only or a complete kit.

title: Dripline Prices in Kenya: 1000 m Rolls & Emitter Spacing | DripTech
description: Compare public dripline price examples for 1000 m rolls in Kenya and understand thickness, emitter spacing, filtration and cost per metre.
intro: Dripline prices depend on wall thickness, emitter spacing, flow rate, roll length and supplier. These public supplier examples are not DripTech selling prices. Confirm the exact product and current stock before buying.

sections.heading: Public reference prices for 1000 m rolls
paragraphs: Faulu Irrigation lists KSh 8,000 for a 0.3 mm, 1000 m roll and KSh 9,000 for a 0.4 mm, 1000 m roll. Aqua Hub's public page lists the same examples for 1000 m rolls, including 15 cm, 20 cm and 30 cm emitter spacing.

Grekkon's public listing quotes dripline from KSh 8.50 per metre and describes options with different thicknesses and spacing. Confirm whether the product is drip tape or integral-emitter dripline, roll length, spacing, flow rate and price unit before comparing.

sections.heading: What affects dripline cost and performance?
bullets: Wall thickness and expected service life
Emitter spacing and flow rate matched to crop and soil
Operating pressure and total length per irrigation zone
Filtration quality and line-flushing routine
Connectors, end caps, mainline pipe, valves and installation

sections.heading: Estimate quantity for your farm
paragraphs: Metres required depend on bed length, row spacing and whether each bed uses one or multiple lines. The roll price alone does not represent the full system cost: mainlines, filtration, fittings, valves and a suitable water supply are also needed.
Public listings were reviewed in October 2026 and may change. Use the calculator for an initial estimate, then verify the layout and hydraulic requirements before ordering.
